hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git push'; then BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if echo "$BRANCH" | grep -q '^claude/'; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Branch name \u2018%s\u2019 starts with claude/ which is an auto-generated name. Rename it to a descriptive name (e.g. feat/..., fix/..., docs/...) before pushing."}' "$BRANCH"; exit 2; fi; fi
